trimmedBy: node trim-ats-a-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by nothing (whole body kept), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: PERMISSION IS UNCLEAR, NOT DOCUMENTED-PUBLIC: the endpoint is documented without credentials, but https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 401, so this host states no robots verdict and the permission field must not read stronger than that. A board that exists but lists nothing: HTTP 200, {"jobs":[],"apiVersion":"1"}, kept whole. (vercel answered the same 28 bytes. Whether such a board is empty or has moved to another ATS cannot be told from the response.) Documented (https://developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/public-job-posting-api): a public endpoint with no credentials in the example; the page states no rate limit or terms of use. robots.txt: https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 401, so NO robots verdict exists for the API host (recorded as such, not as permission). The payload carries NO employer name; employer evidence is the posting text naming the employer. includeCompensation=true was requested; every job carries a compensation object, empty tiers where the employer published none. isListed was true on every one of 1,612 postings across 10 non-empty boards, so no unlisted posting was ever captured. DECISION AND COST: publishedAt is documented as the last publish and is read as PUBLISHED; the content hash covers PUBLISHED, so an Ashby re-publish with identical content changes contentHash (reading it as UPDATED would keep the hash stable but leave Ashby vacancies without a publication date). E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
